description: Ratchet for silent-pass steps (#709, #2678): every step definition that is empty/comment-only, or a Then with no assertion call, named by platform, file, keyword and pattern. A finding that is not listed here fails audit-silent-steps by name. Entries only ever leave: fix the step, then `bun packages/test-specs/tools/audit-silent-steps.ts --write-baseline` drops it. Never add to `known` to make a red run green - fix the step, or add it to `exempt` with the reason it is deliberately empty.

exempt.reason: The workerHub fixture (tests/steps/backend/fixtures.ts) already creates and scopes an isolated hub per scenario; the step only documents that precondition in the Gherkin.

exempt.pattern: hub {string} has no hub-specific ban for that number
exempt.reason: Each scenario gets a fresh hub via the workerHub fixture, so no hub-scoped ban can pre-exist; the step documents scenario intent in the Gherkin.
